name: Fatima Al-Sayed
headline: Research Engineer, NLP
summary: NLP researcher turned engineer. PhD on low-resource Arabic dialects; now building and evaluating large language models for production use.

experience.title: Research Engineer, NLP
bullets: Fine-tune and evaluate Arabic LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face, improving dialect question-answering accuracy by 11 points.
Built a Python evaluation suite covering 14 Arabic dialects that is now the team's release gate.
Cut fine-tuning cost by 40% by moving to LoRA adapters and mixed-precision training.
Containerised training jobs with Docker so experiments reproduce across the shared GPU cluster.

experience.title: Applied Scientist
bullets: Built named-entity recognition models in PyTorch for legal contracts in Arabic and English.
Wrote the annotation guidelines for a 60,000-sentence NLP corpus produced with three external vendors.
Shipped a Python service that redacts personal data from contracts, processing 8,000 documents a day.

education.institution: Gulf University of Science and Technology

projects.name: Dialect-ID benchmark
projects.description: Open benchmark and baseline models for Arabic dialect identification, published on Hugging Face with Python evaluation scripts.
